extended.label: Long
extended.note: 4 Standard-size segments chained end to end and stitched into one clip. Each segment is the same proven size as Standard, so this is about time, not new memory risk — but the Mac doesn't release memory between back-to-back renders, so expect roughly 4x a Standard render's time. Not available with Final yet.

standard.label: Standard
standard.note: Default — best speed/quality on this Mac

final.label: Final
final.note: 720p — ran out of GPU memory on this Mac in testing: it looked done but was blank. The Studio now marks that as failed. Use Draft or Standard.

memory_profile.note: Latent tokens = (w/16)*(h/16)*((frames-1)/4+1). 832x480x81 (32,760) rendered fine on Oct 17 2026; 1280x720x81 (75,600) ran out of GPU memory and came out blank. Job history moves both limits.

negative_default: blurry, low quality, distorted face, extra limbs, warped hands, flicker, jpeg artifacts, watermark, text, subtitles, static frame
